Parse no-touch lists split on commas and semicolons, collect indented continuation lines, expand directory entries to dir/**, normalise a leading ./, resolve declared paths through symlinks to the tracked path, split stars by path separator, and strip fenced blocks before the label is found. A list that yields zero enforceable patterns must be flagged unenforceable and unknown clauses surfaced in NoTouch.unparsed. The step-scoped write index must count only paths from numbered steps, cut away Prove and no-touch/stop lines, and resolve repo-rooted candidates from absolute and relative forms.

1. Replace .LLMDD/tools/cu_scope.py with the hardened implementation below using only standard library imports, explicit annotations, no typing.Any, and the NoTouch shape entries patterns unparsed:

```python
"""Shared CU scope vocabulary: parse a Do NOT touch list into matchable patterns."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from fnmatch import fnmatch
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final, Sequence, TypeAlias

Pattern: TypeAlias = str

NO_TOUCH_LABEL: Final[str] = "Do NOT touch:"

PROSE_TO_GLOB: Final[dict[str, str]] = {
    "any scala source": "**/*.scala",
    "any python tool": ".LLMDD/tools/*.py",
    "any itr frame or feedback file": ".LLMDD/ITRS/**",
    "any itr frame file": ".LLMDD/ITRS/**",
    "any dtr file": ".LLMDD/DTRS/**",
    "any dtr or itr artifact": ".LLMDD/ITRS/**",
}

GLOB_CHARS: Final[str] = "*?["

_ENTRY_SEPARATORS: Final[re.Pattern[str]] = re.compile(r"[;,]")
_PATHISH: Final[re.Pattern[str]] = re.compile(r"^[\w./*-]+$")
_FENCE: Final[re.Pattern[str]] = re.compile(r"```.*?```", re.S)
_STEP: Final[re.Pattern[str]] = re.compile(r"(?m)^(\d+)\.\s")
_EXT: Final[re.Pattern[str]] = re.compile(
    r"[\w./-]+\.(?:py|scala|md|json|itr|txt|sbt|yaml|yml)")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NoTouch:
    entries: Sequence[str]
    patterns: Sequence[Pattern]
    unparsed: Sequence[str]


EMPTY: Final[NoTouch] = NoTouch(entries=(), patterns=(), unparsed=())


def prose_only(body: str) -> str:
    return _FENCE.sub("", body)


def _strip_dot_slash(value: str) -> str:
    stripped: str = value
    while stripped.startswith("./"):
        stripped = stripped[2:]
    return stripped


def _collect_label_lines(prose: str) -> Sequence[str]:
    """Return the label line plus every continuation line under it."""
    collected: list[str] = []
    inside: bool = False
    line: str
    for line in prose.splitlines():
        stripped: str = line.strip()
        if not inside:
            if stripped.startswith(NO_TOUCH_LABEL):
                inside = True
                collected.append(stripped[len(NO_TOUCH_LABEL):])
            continue
        if not stripped:
            break
        if stripped.startswith((NO_TOUCH_LABEL, "Stop when", "Prove:",
                                "Acceptance", "```")):
            break
        collected.append(stripped)
    return collected


def _split_entries(body: str) -> Sequence[str]:
    joined: str = " ".join(_collect_label_lines(prose_only(body)))
    return [part.strip() for part in _ENTRY_SEPARATORS.split(joined) if part.strip()]


def _trim(entry: str) -> str:
    return entry.rstrip(".;:")


def _looks_like_dir(clean: str) -> bool:
    if any(ch in clean for ch in GLOB_CHARS):
        return False
    bare: str = clean.rstrip("/")
    tail: str = bare.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    return "/" in bare and "." not in tail


def _to_pattern(entry: str) -> Pattern | None:
    clean: str = _strip_dot_slash(_trim(entry))
    mapped: str | None = PROSE_TO_GLOB.get(clean.lower())
    if mapped is not None:
        return mapped
    if not _PATHISH.match(clean):
        return None
    if _looks_like_dir(clean):
        return clean.rstrip("/") + "/**"
    return clean


def parse_no_touch(body: str) -> NoTouch:
    entries: Sequence[str] = _split_entries(body)
    patterns: list[Pattern] = []
    unparsed: list[str] = []
    entry: str
    for entry in entries:
        pattern: Pattern | None = _to_pattern(entry)
        if pattern is None:
            unparsed.append(entry)
        else:
            patterns.append(pattern)
    return NoTouch(entries=entries, patterns=tuple(patterns), unparsed=tuple(unparsed))


def has_enforceable_patterns(declared: NoTouch) -> bool:
    """A no-touch list that yields no pattern enforces nothing."""
    return len(declared.patterns) > 0


def resolve_patterns(patterns: Sequence[Pattern], root: Path) -> Sequence[Pattern]:
    """Resolve each non-glob prefix through the filesystem.

    A declared path that traverses a symlink also matches the real tracked
    path git reports, and the real path also matches a declared symlink."""
    resolved_root: Path = root.resolve()
    out: list[Pattern] = []
    pattern: Pattern
    for pattern in patterns:
        out.append(_resolve_pattern(pattern, resolved_root))
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(out))


def _resolve_pattern(pattern: Pattern, resolved_root: Path) -> Pattern:
    parts: Sequence[str] = pattern.split("/")
    head: list[str] = []
    tail: list[str] = []
    part: str
    for part in parts:
        if any(ch in part for ch in GLOB_CHARS):
            break
        head.append(part)
    if not head:
        return pattern
    tail = list(parts[len(head):])
    try:
        resolved: Path = resolved_root.joinpath(*head).resolve()
        relative: Path = resolved.relative_to(resolved_root)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return pattern
    prefix: str = relative.as_posix()
    if prefix == ".":
        return "/".join(tail) if tail else pattern
    return "/".join([prefix] + tail)


def _match_parts(pattern: Sequence[str], path: Sequence[str]) -> bool:
    if not pattern:
        return not path
    head: str = pattern[0]
    if head == "**":
        if _match_parts(pattern[1:], path):
            return True
        return bool(path) and _match_parts(pattern, path[1:])
    if not path:
        return False
    return fnmatch(path[0], head) and _match_parts(pattern[1:], path[1:])


def _matches(pattern: Pattern, path: str) -> bool:
    """Segment-aware glob: a single star never crosses a path separator."""
    return _match_parts(tuple(pattern.split("/")), tuple(path.split("/")))


def is_touched(patterns: Sequence[Pattern], path: str) -> bool:
    normalised: str = _strip_dot_slash(path)
    pattern: Pattern
    for pattern in patterns:
        if _matches(pattern, normalised):
            return True
    return False


def _step_bodies(prose: str) -> Sequence[str]:
    return _STEP.split(prose)[2::2]


def _step_declaration(step: str) -> str:
    cut: str = step.split(NO_TOUCH_LABEL, 1)[0]
    cut = cut.split("Prove:", 1)[0]
    cut = cut.split("Stop when", 1)[0]
    return cut


def _repo_rooted(candidate: str) -> str | None:
    cleaned: str = _strip_dot_slash(candidate)
    prefix: str
    for prefix in ("src", "conf", "project", "docs", "scripts", "itr-buffer",
                   "dtr-builder", "itr-compiler", "commit-tool", ".LLMDD"):
        marker: str = prefix + "/"
        start: int = 0
        while True:
            idx: int = cleaned.find(marker, start)
            if idx == -1:
                break
            if idx == 0 or cleaned[idx - 1] == "/":
                return cleaned[idx:]
            start = idx + 1
    return None


def write_paths(body: str) -> Sequence[str]:
    """Return repo-rooted paths the CU declares it changes.

    Only numbered steps count, only prose outside a fence is read, and the
    Prove and no-touch lines are cut away: a path named in a proof or a
    guard is read, not written."""
    prose: str = prose_only(body)
    found: list[str] = []
    step: str
    for step in _step_bodies(prose):
        candidate: str
        for candidate in _EXT.findall(_step_declaration(step)):
            rooted: str | None = _repo_rooted(candidate)
            if rooted is not None:
                found.append(rooted)
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(found))

```

# ── CU boundary enforcement ────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BoundaryBreach:
    """One boundary violation: which scope, which path, which rule."""
    scope: str
    path: str
    rule: str


def _resolved(declared: NoTouch, project_dir: Path) -> NoTouch:
    """Resolve declared patterns through symlinks against the repo root."""
    return NoTouch(
        entries=declared.entries,
        patterns=resolve_patterns(declared.patterns, project_dir),
        unparsed=declared.unparsed,
    )


def _owned_breaches(writes: CoderWrites,
                    guards: dict[str, NoTouch]) -> Sequence[BoundaryBreach]:
    """Rule 1: a CU that writes a path its own frame forbids fails."""
    declared: NoTouch = guards.get(writes.cu_id, parse_no_touch(""))
    if not has_enforceable_patterns(declared):
        return (BoundaryBreach(scope=writes.cu_id, path="", rule="unenforceable"),)
    found: list[BoundaryBreach] = []
    path: str
    for path in writes.paths:
        if is_touched(declared.patterns, path):
            found.append(BoundaryBreach(scope=writes.cu_id, path=path, rule="no-touch"))
    return tuple(found)


def _collision_breaches(per_cu: Sequence[CoderWrites]) -> Sequence[BoundaryBreach]:
    """Rule 2: two CU scopes writing one path in a wave both fail."""
    owners: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    writes: CoderWrites
    for writes in per_cu:
        path: str
        for path in writes.paths:
            owners.setdefault(path, []).append(writes.cu_id)
    found: list[BoundaryBreach] = []
    path2: str
    ids: list[str]
    for path2, ids in sorted(owners.items()):
        if len(ids) < 2:
            continue
        cu: str
        for cu in ids:
            found.append(BoundaryBreach(scope=cu, path=path2, rule="shared-write"))
    return tuple(found)


def _unattributed_breaches(unattributed: Sequence[str],
                           guards: dict[str, NoTouch]) -> Sequence[BoundaryBreach]:
    """Rule 3: a change no CU claimed is still held to every guard."""
    found: list[BoundaryBreach] = []
    path: str
    for path in unattributed:
        owners: list[str] = [
            cu for cu, declared in guards.items()
            if is_touched(declared.patterns, path)]
        if owners:
            found.append(BoundaryBreach(
                scope="wave", path=path,
                rule="unattributed:" + ",".join(sorted(owners))))
    return tuple(found)


def boundary_breaches(writes: WaveWrites,
                      guards: dict[str, NoTouch]) -> Sequence[BoundaryBreach]:
    """Apply all three rules to one measured wave."""
    found: list[BoundaryBreach] = []
    per: CoderWrites
    for per in writes.per_cu:
        found.extend(_owned_breaches(per, guards))
    found.extend(_collision_breaches(writes.per_cu))
    found.extend(_unattributed_breaches(writes.unattributed, guards))
    return tuple(found)


def report_breaches(breaches: Sequence[BoundaryBreach], feedback_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Print every breach and leave the same record on disk."""
    breach: BoundaryBreach
    for breach in breaches:
        _fail(f"CU boundary {breach.rule}: {breach.scope} -> {breach.path}")
    text: str = "\n".join(
        f"SCOPE={b.scope}\nRULE={b.rule}\nPATH={b.path}\n" for b in breaches)
    match _write_file_text(feedback_dir / "boundary-breaches.txt", text):
        case Ok(_):
            pass
        case Err(e):
            _warn(f"Cannot write boundary report: {e}")


def enforce_boundary(per_cu: Sequence[CoderWrites], project_dir: Path,
                     base_ref: str, baseline_dirty: frozenset[str],
                     guards: dict[str, NoTouch],
                     feedback_dir: Path) -> tuple[Sequence[BoundaryBreach], Sequence[str]]:
    """Measure the wave, attribute it to CUs, and apply every rule."""
    wave_paths: Sequence[str] = wave_writes(project_dir, base_ref, baseline_dirty)
    attributed: WaveWrites = attribute_writes(wave_paths, per_cu)
    breaches: Sequence[BoundaryBreach] = boundary_breaches(attributed, guards)
    if breaches:
        report_breaches(breaches, feedback_dir)
    claimed: set[str] = set()
    writes: CoderWrites
    for writes in per_cu:
        claimed.update(writes.paths)
    return breaches, tuple(sorted(claimed | set(wave_paths)))

```

def _paths_against(paths: Sequence[str], guards: dict[str, NoTouch],
                   scope: str) -> Sequence[BoundaryBreach]:
    """Hold one agent's writes to a set of CU guards."""
    found: list[BoundaryBreach] = []
    path: str
    for path in paths:
        owners: list[str] = [
            cu for cu, declared in guards.items()
            if is_touched(declared.patterns, path)]
        if owners:
            found.append(BoundaryBreach(
                scope=scope, path=path,
                rule="lead:" + ",".join(sorted(owners))))
    return tuple(found)


def _escalated_in(wave_cus: Sequence[str], feedback_dir: Path) -> set[str]:
    """CU ids whose feedback marks STATUS=ESCALATION."""
    found: set[str] = set()
    cu: str
    text: str
    for cu in wave_cus:
        match _read_file_text(feedback_dir / f"{cu}.feedback.txt"):
            case Ok(text) if "STATUS=ESCALATION" in text:
                found.add(cu)
            case _:
                pass
    return found

def _event(tool: str, payload: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    """Render one tool_use line shaped like the opencode JSON stream."""

        "type": "tool", "tool": tool, "state": {"input": payload}}
